history.summary: Rivercove Residences is a 2018-launch EC (TOP ~2020) in Sengkang/D19, 4BR (1,184 sqft) at $1,646 psf / $1.95M, just past its 5-year MOP into the open resale market. ECs typically deliver strong post-MOP appreciation as they re-rate toward private comps, but URA appreciation/median data is missing here so the rate is unverified.
history.rating_rationale: Post-MOP EC in Punggol/Sengkang growth corridor (PDD, CRL ~2030) is a structurally sound thesis with $1.95M sitting in the deep buyer band and strong HDB-upgrader demand. But $1,646 psf is already a full EC price after the MOP pop, the LRT-only access (660m to Layar LRT, no direct MRT) caps it, and no URA data means the appreciation case is unconfirmed. Balanced.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/median data — rate unverified
LRT-only connectivity, no direct MRT line
Much of the EC discount already captured post-MOP
catalysts: Post-MOP EC entering open resale — upgrader demand
D19 Punggol Digital District + CRL ~2030 corridor
